name: Attention-onset long with crowded-LEVEL veto (accel long only when level not extreme) (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: uses the crowded-LEVEL finding as an EXPOSURE GUARD on the long side rather than as a short. Take the attention-onset long (social_volume_accel spike — the CHANGE leads price) ONLY when the crowd LEVEL is NOT already extreme (social_attention_z below a fitted ceiling). The economics: onset attention leads up, but if the crowd is already exhausted (high level) the follow-through is gone and you are buying the blow-off. Combining the CHANGE trigger with a LEVEL veto separates fresh ignition from late euphoria — distinct from both the pure accel long and the level short. Counterparty is late chasers. DISCONFIRMER: ablate the veto — spec-with-veto must beat spec-without out of sample; if the LEVEL ceiling does not improve net-of-fee OOS Sharpe it is just cutting trades, drop it. Shuffle the attention series; the accel edge must collapse under shuffle.
catalyst: fresh attention acceleration while the crowd is not yet exhausted
